prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Fazei o que ele vos disser

meta.face: Christ as in recurring-figures.md: a man of about thirty-three with a LONG OVAL face narrowing gently to the chin — a high, smooth forehead, a long straight nose with a fine bridge, calm almond-shaped dark-brown eyes under level brown brows, high, softly modelled cheekbones, a quiet closed mouth; chestnut-brown hair parted in the centre and falling in soft waves past the shoulders; a short, full chestnut beard and moustache, lightly parted at the chin; a plain gold halo; a rose-red tunic and a blue mantle. Our Lady as in recurring-figures.md, a woman of about forty-six, with a delicate, softly OVAL face — a smooth high forehead, a fine straight nose with a narrow bridge, almond-shaped brown eyes under gently arched light-brown brows, softly rounded cheeks, a small rosy mouth, a small rounded chin; light-brown hair parted in the centre under a white inner veil and a blue mantle drawn over the head. The others are secondary and clearly different: the servant she speaks to, a lad of about fifteen with a narrow, eager face and short black curls; the pouring servant, a stocky man of about forty with a ROUND, ruddy face and a thick black beard; the steward, about sixty, with a LONG, fleshy face, a bulbous nose, raised grey brows and a short white beard; the bride, about sixteen, a HEART-SHAPED face with dark eyes and dark hair under a white veil; the groom, about twenty, a SQUARE-JAWED face with a first dark beard.
meta.basis: John 2:1-11, the first of the signs, painted as the Western tradition does (Mary's intercession, the six stone jars, the steward tasting). Christ and Our Lady from recurring-figures.md; the disciples were left out to keep the scene legible in the window.
